PE.name: Faique
PE.citation: Bussmann & Sharon (2015), Plantas Medicinales de los Andes y la Amazonia, alphabetical index p.147: 'Faique, Espino, Huarango: FABACEAE - Acacia macracantha'. The same volume's discussion of the Moche 'Ulluchu' iconography problem separately notes that Bruning's Mochica-Spanish dictionary (2004) records the historical north-coast Peru Mochica-language term 'faik' for this species, still partially in use today - a genuinely old, still-living name.
